notes.title: Source Code Availability
notes.notes:
I have finally had time to place the source code in a publicly available repository.  I would like to have done this sooner, but have been busy with [b][i]real life[/i][/b], but now have been able to get it done.  The code is available on GitHub at the following link...

[url=https://github.com/ProfPorkins/ThatMakesSense]Source Code[/url]

I wrote this game for [i]fun[/i], as a hobby project; I hope others find the game fun, but the [i]fun for me[/i] is in the technical details of writing the game.  I hope to create some documentation that describes the code architecture and key details, but that is many months away before I'll have time to do that.

When writing the game is was always my intention to make it publicly available so that others can see how it was done, and possibly learn from my work.  Hope someone finds this useful or interesting in some way.

notes.title: Full Game Released!
notes.notes:
The game is done, it's released, enjoy it!

While the game is released, I'm planning to continue to work on the code.  There are some technical improvements I want to make.  While those will likely not change the gameplay, they are things I want to do regardless.  As I did with my first game, am planning to release the source code at some point in the future, along with written documentation of the implementation.

notes.title: v 1.07 - Stealth Release
notes.notes:
This is what I'm calling a "Stealth Release".  This is the full game, all puzzles and achievements are enabled; the game is complete.  Next week I'll tell Steam to promote it as a full release.

+ Steam achievements enabled
+ Removed grass from Tomato

For anyone who has already played the game, all history is reset.  This was done to ensure the Steam achievements are unlocked correctly while playing through the game.

If you have wishlisted the game, now is the time to go ahead and purchase, the game is complete!
